# HCRM — Health Cost & Risk Management

> Health Cost & Risk Management, LLC is a Chicago-based healthcare predictive analytics company (since 2004). Its software, Health Risk Monitor (HRM), normalizes medical and pharmacy claims to over 95% accuracy and forecasts each member's medical cost, pharmacy cost, ER visits and inpatient days for the next 12 months, with compliance against 128 clinical standards of care. SOC 2 Type 2 certified; data stored in the U.S. Contact: info@hcrm.net, (773) 782-6466.
